text:
Ana (Partnerships): Heads up — we need the latest supply snapshot from VoltCloud for the cost model. CSV preferred. Can someone from their team share reserved vs spot columns and eviction profiles?
Lee (VoltCloud Sales): @Ana, happy to send. Want daily availability or weekly buckets for modeling? Also confirm if you need commit-tenor breakdown (1/3/12/36 mo).
Ana (Partnerships): Weekly buckets are fine for the model. Yes include commit-tenor rows. Also we need per-SKU latency premium guidance if available.
Sam (Finance): Quick ask: include committed price (USD/hr), spot floor, and any early-termination fees or rebate mechanics. We'll map to our reserved cost lanes.
Lee (VoltCloud Sales): Will do. Also note: some SKUs support "late-bind" reserved allocation (customer picks region at consumption) — should we expose that separately?
Priya (Ops): Late-bind matters for routing; please include a boolean column. If late-bind true, also include max region count per commit.
Jamal (Eng-Prod): For performance modeling we need eviction P50/P90/P99 (minutes) and typical preemption signal lead time. Even approximate numbers help.
Lee (VoltCloud Sales): Understood. I'll prepare CSV. Example header I'll send so you can confirm format:
```
sku_id,sku_name,region,commit_tenor_months,committed_price_usd_per_hr,spot_floor_usd_per_hr,late_bind,late_bind_max_regions,eviction_p50_min,eviction_p90_min,eviction_p99_min,preempt_signal_min,latency_premium_ms,notes
VC-GPU-A100-80,volt-a100-80,us-west1,12,2.10,0.45,false,0,20,60,240,2,8,"reserved rebate applies after 30d"
VC-GPU-H100-80,volt-h100-80,us-east1,36,3.80,0.75,true,3,15,45,180,5,6,"late-bind eligible; min commit 6mo"
```
Lee (VoltCloud Sales): I'll attach the full CSV shortly to this thread and to the GDrive link: https://drive.google.com/voltcloud/supply-snapshot (read-only).
VendorBot: File uploaded: supply_snapshot_2026-03-18.csv (link)
Ana (Partnerships): Perfect — one more ask: include a column for guaranteed-minimum-capacity (vGPU hours/mo) per commit tier so we can model capacity hedging.
Sam (Finance): And please include currency and billing granularity (hourly vs minute). We'll normalize in our model but it's helpful to have explicit flags.
Priya (Ops): Also add maintenance blackout windows per region if you have them (weekday ranges). That affects scheduled rollouts.
Jamal (Eng-Prod): Noted — when you upload, can you add a small sample of real eviction events (date, sku, region, duration) for last 90 days? We can use it for simulation.
Lee (VoltCloud Sales): Will gather those fields and the sample events. Expect updated CSV + short README in ~2 business days. If anything urgent ping me @lee or email partners@voltcloud.com.
Ana (Partnerships): Thanks @Lee and @VendorBot :thumbsup: We'll validate against the cost model once we ingest. I can follow up with a quick sync next week if discrepancies show up.
Sam (Finance): I'll slot a quick 30m review after upload. Thanks team.
